title: Senior Growth Manager,  UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>This role is based out of our London office.<strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Growth Manager, UK on Reddit’s International Community team, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team responsible for deepening Reddit’s presence in the market. This is not a marketing role. Rather, you will drive user and ecosystem growth by building and scaling communities, executing local growth initiatives, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and leading initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s local ecosystem and user experience.</p> <p>This role combines strategic planning, growth-focused execution, cross-functional influence, market ownership, and community development. In this role, you will have a significant impact on shaping Reddit’s presence and success in the market, driving user and ecosystem growth at scale while strengthening engagement across local communities.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>User & Community Growth Strategies: </strong>Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture local communities. </li> <li><strong>Growth Operations:</strong> Design, launch, and scale local growth programs aimed at strengthening Reddit's ecosystem of users, communities, and contributors. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by continuously testing and evaluating new ideas to reach your objectives.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Serve as the local go-to person for providing market insights and local input to cross-functional teams, including Comms, Product, BD, and Marketing. Coordinate the execution of market-specific initiatives across multiple stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Country Data Ownership: </strong>Monitor key country health KPIs and alert the appropriate teams in the event of significant changes (e.g., DAU, Contributions). Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and develop action plans accordingly.</li> <li><strong>Local representation: </strong>Serve as a local spokesperson for Reddit, building influential relationships and partnerships both on and off the platform to reach and attract new audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Expect From You:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience</li> <li>7+ years of experience in user growth, community growth, product operations, or country expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth programs at scale.</li> <li>Entrepreneurial spirit, strong execution skills and an ability to take initiative and drive projects independently.</li> <li>A strong blend of operational, growth, data, and community/content expertise.</li> <li>Experience building communities and/or growing a user base through on-the-ground initiatives.</li> <li>Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.</li> <li>Passion for combining systems thinking with data analysis to drive impactful decisions.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams, users, content creators, and external partners.</li> <li>Results-oriented mindset with a strong attention to detail and a bias toward execution.</li> <li>Deep understanding of local market culture, including language, current events, politics, customs, traditions, topics of interest, and cultural sensitivities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support</li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health & Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match</li> <li>Private Medical and Dental Scheme</li> <li>Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>Bike to Work scheme</li> <li>Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul> <p>Join us in fulfilling our mission of bringing community, belonging, and empowerment to the world, one community at a time. Become a driving force in shaping the future of Reddit's growth and success around the world.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Front End Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">3058 -  Front-end Engineer - Manchester</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Role Summary and Impact</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p>At Code, we design and build digital products and platforms for a range of clients.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Front-end Engineer with strong browser-side engineering skills who cares about how interfaces work in practice.</p> <p>You’ll work mainly in TypeScript and React, building responsive, accessible and performant interfaces as part of a multidisciplinary product team. We use application frameworks including React Router and Next.js, but strong foundations in HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter just as much.</p> <p>This is a senior engineering role, so you’ll do more than implement designs. You’ll help shape how interfaces are built, work closely with designers on interaction and behaviour, contribute to technical decisions, and help other engineers improve their front-end skills.</p> <p>You’ll also contribute to how we approach front-end engineering across Code, sharing what works and challenging approaches when there’s a better way to do things.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Skills and Experience</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Build high-quality user interfaces using TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS.</li> <li>Work with React Router, Next.js and similar React application frameworks.</li> <li>Work closely with designers to turn ideas and designs into usable, responsive interfaces rather than simply reproducing static screens.</li> <li>Make accessibility part of the way software is designed and built, not something added at the end.</li> <li>Pay close attention to browser performance, loading behaviour and the experience across different devices and connection speeds.</li> <li>Help shape component architecture and contribute to reusable design systems and shared patterns.</li> <li>Write automated tests at the right level, from component and interaction tests through to browser-based end-to-end testing.</li> <li>Review code, talk through approaches and help less experienced engineers develop their skills.</li> <li>Work alongside other engineers to understand APIs, application behaviour and how the front end fits into the wider platform.</li> <li>Contribute to the front-end engineering community at Code, sharing ideas and helping us improve how we build for the web.</li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Highly competent across core front-end skillsets: HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (Vanilla) etc.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559685":426,"335559991":436}"> </span></li> </ul> <p>You’ll have good experience building production web applications and strong browser fundamentals.</p> <p>HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter to us. You should understand how browsers work and be able to build interfaces that are responsive, accessible and robust without relying on a framework to solve everything.</p> <p>You’ll also need solid TypeScript and React experience, with experience working in applications built with React Router, Next.js or similar approaches.</p> <p>Accessibility should be familiar territory. You should understand semantic HTML, keyboard interaction, focus management and the practical application of WCAG when building interfaces. You should also have experience testing interfaces with screen readers and understand how common interaction patterns are experienced by people using assistive technology.</p> <p>Performance matters too. You should be able to investigate and improve things such as loading, rendering, JavaScript execution, images and Core Web Vitals.</p> <p>You’ll need experience with automated testing. The exact tools are less important than knowing what to test and why, but you may have worked with tools such as Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress.</p> <p>Working well with designers is important. That means understanding the intent behind a design, talking through interaction and responsive behaviour, spotting problems and contributing to the solution rather than waiting for every detail to be specified.</p> <p>Experience with design systems, Storybook, design tokens or shared component libraries is useful, particularly if you’ve helped establish patterns rather than simply consumed them.</p> <p>As a senior engineer, you’ll also be expected to support others. You don’t need to have formally managed people, but you should be able to review work, share what you know and help other engineers develop.</p> <p>We don’t expect you to match every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong front-end fundamentals, good engineering judgement and a genuine interest in building accessible, well-crafted web interfaces.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Championing Growth and Development</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Create an Open environment</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. As such, excellent operational team management is essential to ensure all stakeholders are working in unison towards the strategic vision.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build operational AI discoverability excellence across ZEUR, managing varied stakeholders to ensure the successful running of a significant total client budget across above-market and in-market teams.</li> <li>High-level GEO / SEO KPI management and market governance to effectively track performance across Zone.</li> <li>Dominate the delivery of best in-class strategies at a zone level to maximise performance across Nestle Europe. It is vital we’re taking advantage of the short-term opportunities for Nestle whilst laying strong foundations for future changes in search.</li> <li>Work closely with the ZEUR Nestle Search and AI Leads to ensure the strategic focuses align with those of the specific business units.</li> <li>Effective, positive management of a few direct reports and a wider team of AI, GEO and SEO specialists.</li> <li>Build up a constructive, positive rapport with senior client contacts and third-party enablers including content agencies and development teams.</li> <li>A confident presenter with the ability to take what can often be quite complicated concepts, distilling them down into key actions and outcomes for relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Commitment to progressing initiatives focused on driving share of voice and positive consumer experiences on-site.</li> <li>Stay up to date on the latest trends in all things AI discoverability (SEO / GEO / LLM) and adapting the strategy accordingly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Knowledge & Abilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Impressive track record of delivering multimarket SEO strategies and charting subsequent improved business performance. title: Global People & Workplace Specialist (London)
description: As a Global People & Workplace Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting payroll, benefits, and workplace experience for our global team, with a particular focus on our UK-based employees. You will work closely with the People Operations team and cross-functional partners, including Finance, to ensure accurate and timely payroll and benefits administration while also helping create a smooth, engaging, and well-supported workplace experience. Reporting to the Senior Payroll & Benefits Analyst, you will be an integral member of the People Operations team and will support a broad range of high-priority operational initiatives. This role combines detail-oriented payroll and benefits administration with hands-on workplace and employee experience responsibilities, providing essential services that directly impact employees’ day-to-day experience. This is a hybrid role, requiring three days per week in our London office. Responsibilities Manage end-to-end payroll operations in Workday and Deel, including monthly international payroll processing, timesheets, time-off administration, expense approvals, pension remittances, payroll reporting, and related reconciliations Develop, maintain, and continuously improve payroll, benefits, HR, and workplace processes, procedures, controls, and documentation to support accuracy, efficiency, and scalability Ensure compliance with applicable payroll and benefits regulations, including tax, pension, and other statutory requirements Support the day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, pension, Cycle to Work Scheme, and other regional benefits Partner on annual benefits initiatives, including renewals, vendor evaluations, employee engagement initiatives, and other benefits-related projects Conduct regular audits of payroll, benefits, HR data, invoices, and related programs, identifying and resolving discrepancies accurately and promptly Partner closely with the People Operations team to ensure accurate and timely processing of new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations, and other employee lifecycle changes Process and validate employee changes related to tax withholdings, benefit elections, direct deposits, and other payroll or HR updates Review, reconcile, and approve payroll-, benefits-, and workplace-related invoices and expenses Source, evaluate, onboard, and manage vendors across payroll, benefits, workplace services, facilities, food and beverage, and employee programs Oversee day-to-day workplace operations to ensure shared spaces are clean, organized, well stocked, and operating smoothly Develop and manage workplace and employee experience programs, including office lunches, snacks, swag, onboarding support, team gatherings, and company events Plan and execute employee events and workplace initiatives that support engagement, connection, and a positive employee experience Lead facilities projects and coordinate maintenance, repairs, office improvements, and other operational needs Monitor office space utilization, manage workplace inventory, and maintain organized systems that can scale as the company grows Build strong cross-functional relationships and serve as an approachable onsite resource for employees, helping connect workplace operations with broader People and HR needs Serve as a primary resource for employees on payroll, benefits, and workplace-related questions, providing timely, thoughtful, and accurate support Requirements 2+ years of experience in payroll, benefits, People Operations, or a related HR operations function, including hands-on responsibility for payroll processing and benefits administration Experience supporting payroll and/or benefits in the UK, with demonstrated ability to manage differing local requirements, vendors, and processes Strong working knowledge of payroll and benefits compliance requirements, including payroll taxes, statutory benefits, pension requirements, and applicable employment regulations in the UK Exceptional attention to detail and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive employee and payroll information accurately and confidentially Strong employee service and communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain payroll, benefits, and HR-related information and resolve employee questions effectively Experience managing external vendors and coordinating across internal teams to deliver payroll, benefits, workplace, or employee programs Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines while maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment Hands-on experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS/payroll platform, including employee data maintenance, reporting, audits, and payroll-related processes is preferred Experience supporting workplace operations, employee experience programs, facilities, events, or office vendors is a plus Experience with global benefits programs, international payroll vendors, or Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements is a plus Experience supporting a growing or scaling organization is preferred Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience “Friends of Voleon” Candidate Referral Program If you have a For more details regarding eligibility, terms and conditions please make sure to review the Voleon Referral Bonus Program . title: Head of Compliance Product
description: We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI. Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it. You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it. This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence. What you'll do Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done. Lead product for our agentic compliance programme : AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start. Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect. Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways : Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why. Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with. Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences. What this role is not Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme. Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention. Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems. Who we're looking for 10+ years building software products , including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you. A genuine zero-to-one track record : an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on. Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company. Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus. AI-native : AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role. Deep executional rigour : you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line. High self-sufficiency : you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn. Continuous systems thinking : you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster. A data-informed operating style : you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees. Judgement under ambiguity : you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist. Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments : you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and operate well at the tension point between innovation and regulatory reality. Restlessness about velocity and quality : you treat "that's just how long it takes" as a claim to be tested. If you're energised by ownership, invention, and building side by side with customers in a high-stakes domain, we'd love to hear from you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description: About Ultralytics: At Ultralytics , we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models . If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team. 🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special. ⚡ Who we are At Ultralytics , we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone . As the creators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models , we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications. Explore our work on GitHub . Following our $30M Series A round , we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs in London, Madrid, and Shenzhen . Join a fast-scaling, high-performance team redefining vision AI, where ambition meets impact and ideas become reality. We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together. 💼 About the role As Talent Acquisition Partner , you'll help Ultralytics scale and build the teams behind the YOLO ecosystem. You'll own full-cycle recruiting for technical and go-to-market roles across the UK, China, Spain, and the USA. You'll partner with global hiring managers to shape sourcing strategies, assess candidates, share market insights, and streamline hiring. From machine learning and computer vision recruitment to compensation planning and offer negotiation, you'll deliver a thoughtful candidate experience at every stage. This role is ideal for a hands-on recruiter with early stage experience or specialist agency experience in highly technical hiring. You'll balance urgency with rigorous, values-aligned decisions and help build strong teams. 🚀 What you'll do Recruiting strategy & execution Own full-cycle recruiting from intake and process design through outreach, negotiation, and close. Build sourcing strategies and talent pipelines using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, ATS platforms, and referrals. Recruit technical, AI, machine learning, computer vision, and go-to-market talent across global markets. Hiring partnership & process Advise hiring managers on role requirements, candidate suitability, and current market insights. Improve hiring workflows in Ashby, Rippling, and other ATS platforms for speed and rigor. Track pipeline health, hiring outcomes, and process efficiency through recruiting analytics. Candidate experience & growth Deliver clear, responsive candidate experiences and strengthen Ultralytics' employer brand. Support compensation planning and guide hiring teams through offers and negotiations. Coordinate hiring across China, the UK, Spain, and the USA, including multiple time zones. 🧠 Skills and experience Core requirements Experience as an in-house talent partner or specialist agency recruiter. Proven success in full-cycle recruiting, sourcing strategy, and talent pipeline development. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, ATS platforms, and recruiting analytics. Strong hiring manager partnership, candidate assessment, offer negotiation, and compensation planning skills. Experience supporting global hiring with speed, rigor, and a positive candidate experience. Nice to have Technical hiring experience in AI, machine learning, or computer vision; explore our YOLO documentation and guides . Familiarity with OKR frameworks and hiring metrics. Experience coordinating distributed teams across multiple time zones. Understanding of employer branding and developer communities, such as the Ultralytics Community . Strong alignment with our values and interest in AI and computer vision. 🌟 Cultural fit At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork . We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact. You'll thrive here if you: Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability. Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure. See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress. Our culture is built around our core values: Relentless progress: Constant evolution and improvement. Strive for excellence: Perseverance and attention to detail. Actions, not words: Focus on delivering meaningful results. Act with urgency: Seize fleeting opportunities. Open access to all: Transparent communication and collaboration. Learn more in our Ultralytics Handbook . 💰 Compensation and benefits We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title. Competitive salary: Reflecting your experience and contribution. Equity packages: We want our success to be yours too. On-site collaboration: Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs. Flexible working hours: We value results over routines. Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays. Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices. Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3. Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth. High impact: Your work will shape the future of vision AI. 👉 Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture , values, and teams. 🌎 Where and how you can work We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose. This role is on-site at our London hub . Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country of application. We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen. 🚀 Why join us We're not just building models — we're building the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI . If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment. ⚡ Ready to build the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI? Apply now. What we offer: Cutting-Edge, Next-Generation AI Computer Vision Technology: Contribute to building cutting-edge computer vision AI models based on the YOLO framework. Impactful Work: Shape the future of AI-powered solutions that transform industries. Collaborative Culture: Join a talented and passionate team that values open communication and innovation. This handbook is designed to provide key insights and resources for our (future) team members, collaborators, and community to align with Ultralytics' core principles. partnering with customers to scope, design, and deliver solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python and experience building production applications</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working with high-growth, tech-forward companies</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to context-switch across industries (healthcare, fintech, etc.) and use cases</p> </li> <li> <p>Builder credibility that earns trust with technical founders and engineering leaders - you've shipped products and can speak from experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience facilitating technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events</p> </li> <li> <p>Passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£225,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£255,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p> <p><strong>About Beneficial Deployments</strong> </p> <p>Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences - focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. This is a partner-facing role: you'll support nonprofits, research institutes, academic medical centres and public-sector funders as they use Claude to get treatments to patients with rare and neglected diseases, where there is little or no commercial incentive to fund development.</p> <p>The role focuses on two areas where we think Claude can help these partners today. The first is clinical trials. Trials in these diseases have small patient populations, investigator-led or nonprofit funding and little operational support, and they often stall on protocol quality, operational risk and site start-up. Claude can help teams design better trials and start them sooner. The second is drug repurposing: finding new uses for approved, usually off-patent or generic medicines, whose known safety profiles can let a good hypothesis reach patients years sooner than a new molecule.</p> <p>You'll advise and embed in partners' teams, building alongside their engineers, scientists and clinicians.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with partners' trial teams to design, review and prioritise clinical trials with Claude: drafting and reviewing protocols and statistical analysis plans, and flagging enrolment and operational risks.</li> <li>Build and validate tools that help partners find new uses for approved, mostly off-patent medicines in rare and neglected diseases, from literature, omics and patient data, and assemble the evidence so the partner can decide the next step.</li> <li>Build reusable infrastructure other institutions can adopt (MCP servers for biomedical data sources, agent skills, benchmarks grounded in real clinical questions), and feed what you learn in the field back to product, engineering and research.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience designing, running or analysing clinical trials, or finding new uses for existing medicines. Deep experience in one; both are a bonus. Having contributed to a regulatory submission for a trial is a plus.</li> <li>Comfort with biomedical data: literature, omics, and real-world patient data (health records, registries, claims), ideally inside secure or trusted research environments.</li> <li>Strong engineering skills: you can take an LLM-powered tool from prototype to production code, and write evals to measure it.</li> <li>Experience working directly with external partners or customers in a technical role.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication: docs other institutes can use without you, and results clinicians trust.</li> <li>A scrappy mentality: you're comfortable in ambiguity, wear several hats, and do what it takes to get a result for a partner.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£225,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£255,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit <u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u> directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. What does a AI Producer do at WPP Production? We are looking for an AI Producer to support the delivery of innovative, technology-enabled content and campaigns across multiple channels and formats. This role is ideal for a producer with agency or production-house experience who is curious about emerging AI workflows and excited to help shape the future of creative production. The AI Producer will manage projects end-to-end while collaborating with creative, strategy, production, motion, CGI, OOH, and technology teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. The role requires a strong understanding of integrated production workflows, emerging AI tools, and the operational and legal considerations involved in modern content creation. The successful candidate will be highly organised, solutions-oriented, eager to learn, and passionate about production, technology, and creativity. Key Areas of Responsibility Communication Act as a key day-to-day contact for clients, agency partners, and internal stakeholders across projects Support communication between creative, production, strategists, technologists, editors, motion designers, CGI artists, and external vendors Foster strong working relationships across local and global production teams Support and mentor junior team members where appropriate Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and solutions-focused production culture Process Manage medium- to large-scale integrated production projects from briefing through delivery Support productions across AI-led content creation Coordinate schedules, budgets, approvals, assets, deliverables, and production workflows across multiple projects simultaneously Help evaluate and implement AI tools and workflows within production pipelines Maintain clear documentation including timelines, trackers, meeting notes, status reports, and risk management Ensure projects are delivered on brief, on brand, on time, and on budget Financial Management Assist with project scoping, budgeting, estimates, and reconciliations Track project costs, vendor management, POs, billing, and financial reporting Partner with production, finance, and operations teams to ensure commercial accuracy and efficiency Support cost-effective production solutions while maintaining creative quality Legal & Compliance Awareness Maintain a basic understanding of legal, compliance, and usage considerations related to AI-generated content and production workflows Support adherence to licensing, talent usage, rights management, and content governance requirements Ensure production processes align with client, platform, and company compliance standards Escalate legal or compliance concerns to relevant teams when needed Day-to-Day Responsibilities May Include Developing and maintaining project scopes, timelines, and budgets Coordinating with WPP Production's global production network to support integrated campaign launches Managing day-to-day communication with clients, agencies, suppliers, and internal teams Supporting productions involving AI-generated content title: Senior Sales Director
description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Role Description: Plume works with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to run the connected experience inside their subscribers' homes and small businesses. Our platform sits between their network and the people using it, managing WiFi performance, security, device visibility, care and the digital services layered on top. We are used at scale by some of the largest ISPs across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. The UK and Ireland are mature and concentrated markets. The number of ISPs that matter is small, they are well known to us, and most already have an established approach to managing the connected home. Success here depends on building credibility at a senior level, shaping how these organisations think about the experience they deliver to their subscribers, and then proving that value at scale. We are looking for someone who is at their best in a small number of large, complex accounts rather than in a broad prospecting territory. It is a role with real ownership. You will be the face of Plume in the region, working directly with our executive team and with senior leaders at some of the best-known ISPs in the market. Responsibilities: • A named list of UK and Ireland ISPs, covering both new logos and the growth of existing deployments into new services, subscriber tiers and lines of business. • A multi-million-dollar annual quota carried across new business and installed base expansion. • The full cycle: executive access, discovery, business case, technical validation and POC, commercial modelling, procurement, contract, and a clean handover into delivery. You stay accountable through launch. • The relationship map inside each account. Not a single champion, but the CTO, the Chief Product or Consumer officer, the owner of customer care and operations, and whoever holds the broadband P&L. • A virtual team pulled from solutions engineering, product, delivery, finance, legal and executive sponsorship. You direct it. You do not wait for it. • Accurate forecasting. Deals of this size move, and we would rather know early than late. • A clear read on the market: how ISPs in the region are approaching the connected home, where their priorities are shifting, and what that means for our roadmap. You are our eyes in the territory. Qualifications: This role calls for someone who already understands how ISPs buy. Their decision cycles, stakeholder structures and commercial models are specific to the industry, and the experience we are looking for reflects that. • A track record selling hardware, software, cloud or platform solutions directly to ISPs, with evidence of recurring or subscription-based commercial models. Your experience should be with ISPs as the buyer, rather than with a telco's enterprise IT function as one account among many. • Ownership of deals in the multi-million-dollar ACV range, with 9 to 24 month cycles, formal procurement, and an established solution already in place. • Fluency in ISP economics. ARPU and attach rates, churn and retention drivers, cost to serve, contact volumes and handling time, truck roll avoidance, CPE fleet lifecycle and ODM relationships, NPS. You should be able to build a credible business case yourself before a solutions engineer is in the room. • Experience winning business where the customer already had a solution in place, whether bought or built in-house. That is a different commercial conversation, and we place real weight on it. • Existing senior relationships across UK and Ireland ISPs, or a specific and realistic plan for building them inside two quarters. • MEDDPICC applied in practice rather than in theory. Expect to walk us through a live deal from your current role against it. • Comfort operating without a finished playbook. Our product moves, our commercial models evolve, and parts of this territory are still being defined. You will be building as you sell. • Consistent quota attainment, and the ability to explain honestly where you missed and why. • Willingness to travel regularly across UK and Ireland, and occasionally across EMEA. About Plume As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture. title: Creative Director, Fundraising and Mobilization (Evergreen)
description: Interested in joining Blue State's Creative Director team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission. If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to. What to know Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we're delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands' social impact teams. We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We're looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking. We're interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals. The company Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London. A day in the life Lead and inspire: Working closely with your colleagues, you'll develop a vision for our client's creative success. You'll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery. Create with purpose: Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality. Accountability: Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects. Foster a culture of collaboration and creativity: Stay on top of developments in the field, industry, and culture. Help identify, hire and retain designers, copywriters, and other creatives. Mentor junior members of the project team. What we offer Unlimited time off (inclusive of sick, personal and vacation days) $1,000 annual in professional development funds (local equivalent) Fully subsidised health and dental insurance for employees (subject to tax) Generous pension match via salary sacrifice Generous paid holiday schedule Parental leave policy for up to 32.5 week of coverage at full pay, inclusive of all genders and supporting a range of family structures Group Income Protection (GIP) Group Life Assurance (GLA) Optional holiday travel insurance Pre-tax season ticket loans Cycle to work (up to £2000) Remote work flexibility We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week. The team You'll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we're creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration. Role Description As Supplier Coordinator/Analyst, you'll be at the centre of how Product manages its suppliers - making sure Allica stays on top of every review, renewal and requirement across a fast-growing supplier estate, in line with our TPRM framework. This is an individual contributor role built for someone who thrives on staying ahead of things: you're the person Product comes to for a clear answer on what's due and what's outstanding, and the one who catches a licence, renewal or review before it becomes due. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in. 2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space. This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers. About the Role As a Customer Operations Associate, you’ll join our Transfers team within Operations, where your initial focus will be on building deep expertise in transfers and delivering great outcomes for our customers. You’ll help customers move their investment accounts and assets into and out of Freetrade, owning cases from start to finish and working with customers, external counterparties and teams across the business to make sure transfers are completed accurately, efficiently and within the required timelines. This is detailed, deadline-driven work where accuracy, ownership and follow-through really matter. You’ll develop a strong understanding of the rules and regulations governing ISA transfers, alongside the operational processes involved in cash and stock transfers, valuations, asset acceptance and CREST. You will also build experience across areas such as JISAs, fund transfers and European stock transfers. At the centre of the role is genuine care about getting the customer the right outcome. We’re looking for people who take ownership, care deeply about the experience customers have and are willing to follow a problem through until it’s resolved. Your initial focus will be Transfers, but our longer-term ambition is to build a more cross-trained and flexible Operations team. As you develop, there may be opportunities to gain exposure to other areas such as Payments, Corporate Actions, Trading & Settlements, Customer Service and Complaints, helping you build a broader understanding of how Operations works and how different workflows connect. This isn’t a rotation programme, and there’s no set timeline or expectation that you’ll move between teams. Opportunities to broaden your knowledge will depend on your development, team priorities and the needs of the business. Our aim is to develop operators with both depth and breadth across Operations - people who understand their own area deeply, can connect the dots across different workflows and use that knowledge to get better outcomes for customers. AI and automation are a real part of how Operations is evolving at Freetrade. We’re looking for people who are genuinely enthusiastic about using technology to continuously improve their work - actively finding ways to work faster and smarter and contributing to automation and efficiency improvements as they go. What You'll Do Own transfer cases from start to finish, helping customers move ISA, JISA, GIA and SIPP accounts and assets into and out of Freetrade, with a focus on accuracy and a smooth customer outcome Process transfer applications accurately and within agreed SLAs. Chase and monitor transfer progress with external counterparties and customers, taking ownership of cases through to completion. Build a strong working knowledge of ISA and SIPP transfer rules, regulations and operational requirements. Work with CREST processes and develop your understanding of stock and asset transfers. Provide technical support to our Customer Service team, helping them answer customer queries accurately and efficiently. Communicate clearly with customers through email and in-app chat and, as our support channels evolve, potentially phone. In an era where exploits and supply chain attacks are being discovered and conducted faster than ever before, it’s vital that we stay on the cutting edge of keeping our systems and our customers’ data safe. Hardening our systems is only part of the solution. As we scale out to more industries with their diverse security requirements, we want another individual who can help us attain and maintain higher levels of compliance certification. What We're Looking For We're hiring at both Level 3 (Senior) and Level 4 (Staff) . For calibration, candidates typically bring 5+ years of platform engineering experience in high-growth, cloud-native SaaS environments, but we care more about impact than years. We’re looking for that “T”-shaped skillset where the candidate’s depth is in Cloud Security. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have a product engineering background but caught the bug for security and cares deeply about enabling people to work fast, safely. Finally, we’re looking for someone who sees security as an enabler and force-multiplier and answers questions with a “Yes, here’s how we do it securely” attitude as opposed to the flat “No” security teams are too often renowned for. What You'll Do Implement and take ownership of our Security roadmap. Working with the Platform Lead, a successful candidate will steadily take ownership over the Platform Security Roadmap, leading implementations and experiments to level up Omnea’s security posture. Own Security Tooling. From safe-chain plugins to SAST/DAST tooling, we want someone who’s keen to get stuck in, onboard, and evolve our tooling to ensure our posture stays at the bleeding edge. Deliver Compliance Programs. Omnea plans to tackle multiple additional compliance certifications to enable the business to serve some of the most regulated industries on the planet. You’ll have a massive hand in making sure we’re up to those standards. Collaborate with our DevX streams. Omnea ships fast, and we want to ship even faster. Making sure we can enable that safely and securely will become your wheelhouse. Implement hardening patterns. See an area where code security could be improved? Let’s do it, and do it in a way that can be scaled out across the entire codebase and easily implemented by the rest of the engineering staff. What Can You Expect? A strong team. You'll join a platform team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will push you to do your best work. Modern, cloud-native stack. Everything serverless and IaC-driven (AWS, Pulumi, TypeScript end-to-end). Continuous delivery. We deploy multiple times a day. Your work determines how fast and safely the whole engineering org ships. Scalability challenges. As we 10x revenue, you'll be a part of evolving our infrastructure to defend against new security threats and keep us one step ahead. Customer impact. Delivering on our compliance goals and successfully handling audits. Massive ownership. You own problems end-to-end, from brainstorming through to production. Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership. About You Platform engineer & builder. You design reliable infrastructure and write clean production code (TypeScript or similar). You've built and maintained CI/CD pipelines, IaC, and security gates at scale. Cloud-native. Deep knowledge of AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, IAM, networking), or equivalent cloud-native experience. You understand serverless and its trade-offs. Security as an enabler. You think about engineers and business as your customers. You automate toil, improve feedback loops, and care deeply about making other people productive. Commercially minded. You understand that infrastructure & security exist to serve the product and the business. You make trade-offs with that in mind. Bias for action. You iterate quickly, ship pragmatically, and automate everything. Culture carrier. You coach teammates, share knowledge freely, and keep calm when things break. Nice-to-haves Experience with Pulumi or similar IaC frameworks. ISC2 (any level) certification. Experience running SaaS compliance programs (ISO:27001, SOC 2 Type II). Open-source contributions to security, infrastructure, or developer tooling projects. You can learn more about Engineering at Omnea and our hiring process via our R&D Candidate Hub here. At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).
